g.text: Google API throughput sits inside the all-surfaces figure

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Two Google disclosures on a common monthly basis. The all-surfaces figure already contains the model-API figure, so the

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: two describe nested volumes rather than separate ones.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Alphabet Q2 2026 earnings; Google I/O 2026 keynote

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: These two figures must never be added together. The API figure is a spot rate of 22 billion tokens/minute (Q2 2026) put on a

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: 30.44-day month; the all-surfaces figure is disclosed directly as over 3.2 quadrillion tokens/month (May 2026). The dates differ and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the all-surfaces figure spans multimodal and consumer traffic, so the gap shown is indicative of scope, not a precise residual.
